integrity: Direct finite-dimensional exact arithmetic tests supplement, but do not establish, the unrestricted analytical theorem. Scientific self-review completed; no independent validation is claimed.
scientific_limitations: Stochastic-channel domination is proved for correlations in [0,1]; binomial and limit formulas require homogeneous bias; Gaussian-Hermite asymptotics require fixed k and interior q. A previous result covers the special rho=0 first-chaos case; historical priority outside inspected literature remains uncertain.
title: Rare-vertex domination and sharp derivative norms for biased Boolean noise semigroups
